value.name: recognizes his emotional disassembly
value.description: She realizes he is not performing and instead is a man emotionally broken by the earlier confrontation in his mother's dining room.
evidence: He was not, she saw, performing.
He was asking the question of a man who had just been disassembled in his mother's dining room and who did not know how to put himself back together alone

value.name: reflects on professional boundaries
value.description: She weighs compassion against neutrality and reminds herself she was hired by the estate, not the family.
evidence: She thought about her professional guarding.
She thought about the line between compassion and neutrality.
She thought about the fact that she had been retained by an estate and not by a family, and that the estate did not eat lunch.

value.name: ends lunch and assigns next steps
value.description: She thanks the others, says she must call Mr. Halloran, and directs Marcus to work in the front parlor for the next hour before she returns to the office.
evidence: "I have to make the call to Mr. Halloran. Marcus and I will work in the front parlor for the next hour, if that's all right with everyone. After that I'll need to go back to the office."

value.name: schedules follow-up with Serrano family
value.description: She tells Mr. Serrano and the Serrano women that she will see them the next morning to discuss matters further.
evidence: "But Mr. Serrano — I'll see you tomorrow morning. We have a great deal to discuss."

value.name: collects documents and leaves dining room
value.description: She gathers the folder, envelope, and letter into the banker's box, acknowledges Marcus, and exits the dining room.
evidence: She took the green folder and the white envelope and the letter, and she put them carefully in the banker's box, and she nodded to Marcus, and she walked out of the dining room into the front hall.

value.name: pauses at newel post
value.description: In the hall, she pauses and rests her hand on the newel post where Daniel had touched it earlier, briefly leaning into the quiet house.
evidence: In the hall she stopped for a moment.
She put her hand on the newel post where Daniel's hand had been twenty minutes earlier and she let her own weight rest on it briefly.

value.name: registers the house's silence
value.description: She notices the warmth of the wood, the stillness of the house, and the ticking radiator as the scene settles into quiet.
evidence: Somewhere in the kitchen a radiator ticked.
